findings.message: 211301 WALL - SKIN - SIDE LOWER - LH has no drawing, and D-89 part 4 (flat sheet part on its DXF) doesn't apply: its DXF draws on BEND; only CUT and MARK pass, so it is folded; it isn't a sheet part (46.0 thick across 1142.7); its row's process names fold, groove.
findings.fix: Make its drawing; or, for a flat part cut from sheet with no bends and no machined features, give the full outline and every hole in its DXF and material, thickness, finish, ISO 2768-m and any critical hole note in its parts-list row (D-89 part 4).

findings.message: 211501 WALL - CAVITY FILL - SIDE LOWER - LH has no drawing, and D-89's cut-list route doesn't apply: its row names pockets, so it isn't a plain rectangle.
findings.fix: For a plain knife-cut rectangle or strip, give part number, size, material and tolerance in its parts-list or cut-list row (D-89); otherwise make a drawing.
